profile.description: 2027 provider-opportunity lead discovered while filling the leg manager's post-Labor-Day route. The 2026 festival already advertises inflatables and family activities, so outreach should introduce Adventure Zone as a possible larger/different provider for next year rather than pushing into the current setup.

notes.subject: 2027 provider opportunity - Boise Fall Festival
notes.body: 2026 Boise Fall Festival is Saturday Sept. 12, 10 AM-4 PM at Expo Idaho, 5610 N Glenwood St, Boise ID. Current official event information already advertises inflatables, face painting, pony rides and other family activities. Use a respectful 2027 provider-alternative angle rather than pitching ourselves into the existing 2026 entertainment lineup. IBL Events is the producer; current contact is 208-376-0464 and info@ibleventsinc.com. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found for this event. Old Farmer's Almanac currently shows Sept. 12-21 as sunny then a few showers for the Intermountain region; weather is not a reason to exclude pay-for-play, but prepaid should still be led with. Sources verified Aug. 27, 2026: iblevents.com, Expo Idaho, Old Farmer's Almanac.

followUps.label: 2027 provider intro follow-up
followUps.reason: After the 2027 introduction draft is sent, follow up with IBL Events if they have not replied about using Adventure Zone as a larger/different family-entertainment provider next year.
